assumptions.storage: V is pressure-supporting storage in mm3, P=V/C in Pa relative to zero field; zero unstressed volume, not measured total anatomical blood volume
assumptions.conductance: Explicit mm3/(Pa*s) coefficients, never estimated from voxel-face area or radius alone
assumptions.compliance: Explicit mm3/Pa coefficients; no autoregulation, collapse, pulsatility or systemic-volume model
assumptions.boundaries: Declared nonnegative constant gauge pressures with separately integrated signed inflow/outflow; no patient ICP or estimated heart-height correction
assumptions.geometry: Physical graph edges bind one oriented source-neighbor face and explicit vessel source cells; abstract links have no acquired geometry
assumptions.compression: Actual closed bipolar electrode contact with forceN/fullCompressionForceN linear proxy, including contacted wound ports; reversible and uncalibrated
assumptions.occlusion: Persistent edge conductance loss with accumulated power_fraction*s / declared coagulation dose; no wound required
assumptions.transection: Categorical disconnection plus two separately supplied endpoint ports; unmatched source faces refused
assumptions.seal: Only contacted stumps seal; neither coagulation nor compression reconnects a cut edge; an earlier intact occlusion does not automatically seal a future cut
assumptions.clot: Exponential decline of each wound conductance, explicit uncalibrated rate; no field-pressure/tamponade feedback
assumptions.regional_endpoints: Explicit signed supply/drainage interfaces and positive flow targets; integrated missing-flow mm3 and normalized deficit seconds, plus storage change; no oxygen or injury interpretation
assumptions.field_handoff: Pending integrated per-port volumes validated and consumed once before any field mutation; blocked outlets retain already emitted fluid outside vascular storage

Analytic isolated two-stump drainage without duplicated storage
Analytic boundary reversal inside one interval, checking separate in/out ledgers
Intact arterial occlusion without hemorrhage; supply deficit
Venous occlusion without hemorrhage; distinct drainage deficit and storage rise
Alternate signed collateral drain with reversed flow and reduced storage accumulation
Progressive stump sealing, persistent cut continuity loss and distal backbleeding
Time partitions, blocked/open outlet, duplicate/missing/wrong-duration handoff and zero duration
Adversarial source IDs, source cells and incomplete/nonfinite source ledgers fail before mutation
Source-frame invariance, immutable-source refusal and unmapped vessel uncertainty
Public bipolar geometry compression, release, occlusion, outcome export and canonical replay
Existing RL reward refuses graph scenes because it omits supply/drainage consequences

sources.study: Olufsen et al. 2002, cerebral flow regulation
sources.supports: Lumped resistance/compliance abstraction; fitted finger pressure and MCA Doppler responses in ten healthy subjects during posture change
sources.does_not_validate: Surgical wound coefficients, local tissue delivery or this model's numerical parameters

sources.study: Nguyen et al. 2011, rat ascending venular occlusion
sources.supports: Measured upstream RBC-speed reductions, flow reversals and collateral dependence
sources.does_not_validate: Patient surgical injury or clean occlusion blood loss; induction itself can cause local injury and extravasation

sources.study: Blinder et al. 2013, reconstructed mouse cortical networks
sources.supports: Topology, edge resistance and boundary conditions affect flow redistribution; radius alone does not identify tissue delivery
sources.does_not_validate: Complete human microvascular anatomy, low-flow arrest, wound kinetics or neurological endpoints
